user.title: Connect Tick
user.description: Connect Home Assistant to your Tick. In Tick: Settings → Advanced → Keys → New key, access "Full access", named for example "Home Assistant". Paste that key here. Revoking the key in Tick disconnects Home Assistant at once. The address is in the same place in Tick, with a Copy button.

data_description.api_key: Starts with tick_. Tick shows it only once.

reauth_confirm.title: New key for Tick
reauth_confirm.description: Tick no longer accepts the key for {url}. Make a new one in Tick (Settings → Advanced → Keys) and paste it here.

reconfigure.title: Change the connection
reconfigure.description: A new address for your Tick, with a key made in that Tick (Settings → Advanced → Keys shows the address with a Copy button). The triggers stay.

error.invalid_auth: Tick does not accept this key. Check that it is a key with full access and that it was not revoked.
error.not_enabled: This Tick does not have Home Assistant triggers switched on yet.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Tick at this address.

user.title: Add trigger
user.description: A trigger is a moment you can pick for a task in Tick, like "Sam comes home" or "The sun sets". Give it a name as you want to read it in Tick, then choose what Home Assistant watches. On the next screen you choose the state (for example Home or On) and, if you like, conditions. Leave the entity empty for a trigger that only goes off from its button or your own automation.

data_description.name: Short and clear: who or what, and what happens. For example "Sam comes home", "Sunset", "Bathroom light on".
data_description.entity_id: A person, the sun, a light, a door sensor… Optional. Next: the state.

state.title: When does "{name}" go off?
state.description: Choose the state {entity} has to change to, and optionally when it counts.

data.for: Only after it stayed so for

data_description.to_state: Tick is told the moment it changes to this state.
data_description.for: Optional. For example 5 minutes: a short visit or a light that is on for a moment does not count.
data_description.after: Optional. Before this time it does not go off.
data_description.before: Optional. From this time it does not go off. From 22:00 until 06:00 works over midnight.
